# Proposed windows-reservation02 qualification

Status: prepared, not executed or admitted. Root must review the exact source,
tests, launcher and PINS before one first run. No native launch is included.

Use the retained C:\Python314\python.exe with -I -S -B, the copied
qualify_windows_reservations.py, and explicit IG_FORBIDDEN_LIVE set before child
startup. run_preflight01.ps1 requires a fresh windows-reservation02 output,
approved root admission for that exact label and PINS digest, and exactly 28
flat input bindings. Copy and verify those inputs and all three control records
before invoking the child. Scrub provider credentials and Python/proxy variables.
No account, downloaded package, interpreter site processing or model is used.

The runner derives from the qualified 42-case reservation runner preserved in
origins. It adds only contextlib/hmac/re/stat stdlib preloads for the fixed source
imports and explicitly loads 17 reviewed local modules from bounded captured
bytes. It executes their definitions under the existing closed content/import,
12 metadata traps and 25 baseline-winreg callable traps. No ctypes/native library
or process/pipe service is installed. The current C314 built-in winreg startup
expectation is inherited from the preserved successful reservation42 and prior
lcs02 evidence; this proposal runs no new startup probe.

Execute the unchanged 42 original case bodies, with only the fixed fake kernel's
new finish_start method to match the split interface, followed by 23 new cases.
The exact 65 ordered case IDs are in EXPECTED-CASES.json. Nested subtests are
recorded within their parent cases and are not extra test counts. The new module
imports the original test module instead of exposing its TestCase class directly,
avoiding accidental duplicate discovery.

The new controls exercise the actual Windows journal/gate source against fixed
in-memory FFI/handle/disk services, including second-registry exclusion, partial
writes, ancestor/result/identity failures, cached confirmation poisoning, close
failure and the closed real entry. They exercise the actual durable split's
finish ordering, failure stop and late publication refusal. The actual migrated
adapter and its no-worker flow are called against fake services; original read-set
retirement source runs with an inert handle-close port. Checks cover ensure_assets,
initial admission failure, fresh generation on the same registry, retained gate
on cleanup failure, invalid no-worker states, exact durable-factory acceptance
and old-factory refusal. Fake service behavior does not qualify Windows semantics.

The runner compares exact ordered membership and all ten final guard conditions,
including unchanged refusal entrypoints, absent resolver approval and restored
adapter service globals. It records every actual case outcome, nested failure,
guard result, source digest and elapsed time. Content reads remain closed after
source capture. The 256-KiB receipt cap remains unchanged. These controls constrain
content/import/metadata and reviewed API behavior; they are not an OS sandbox.

The launcher sets PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference=false immediately before
the child, captures global:LASTEXITCODE without a local reset, and writes the native
exit receipt before postchecks. It then verifies all original/copied inputs and
controls, empty stderr, exact 65 membership, all guard fields and true exits.
Preserve the actual outer tool object separately. Any failure stays failed; stop
and write a repair brief before any new label. No retry is authorized here.

This proposed observation cannot establish actual cross-process Windows locks,
FlushFileBuffers behavior, native ABI/cancellation, startup/IPC liveness, restart
reconciliation, real namespace authority, installed runtime or model readiness.
Those remain separate concrete generated-native protocols after source review.

_scratch/real-startup-authority-repair01/REPORT.md SHA256 46599CC0F77B5BBFB8EC209E9BC53ED598D44EE8A362FE62103ECC21694F3549
This proposal retains controller startup authority before a worker exists. It is source and proposed tests only. The complete qualified adapter remains the byte-identical prefix of asr_loading_adapter.py; its generated _OwnedASRStart, _model_session and public wrappers are unchanged.

The separate _controller_startup_scope checks the current real approval, release, profile and exact durable manager/factory before lease work. It retains an attempt before fallible work, then the actual returned lease, Admission, LocalBinding and native permit. Admission intentionally reparses the approved manifest, so the initial manifest and admission manifest are retained separately and compared; selection is the exact model inside the latter. Identity registration and immutable value snapshots prevent reconstructed startup/selection records or same-value foreign permits from providing issuance authority. Validation rechecks current configuration, record/protection, local permit, reservation and selected semantics. Consumption requires the actual live pre-worker OwnedSession and is single-use.

The record stays controller-local. This unit creates no IPC trust witness, child-local namespace lease, authenticated adoption payload, model buffer, VAD state or constructor connection. _fixed_real_worker_start explicitly refuses because authenticated child transport, runtime state and a fixed real bootstrap remain absent. No public session wrapper calls this new path. REAL_APPROVAL, RELEASE_AUTHORITY and RUNTIME_PROFILE remain None in source. D3/D4 remain separate decisions; D1/D2 are not accessed.

Once a native permit is reserved, leaving this unfinished seam does not claim clean no-worker retirement. The existing exception-aware lease quarantines it. Startup custody and any actual factory-created session remain retained; first exceptions retain their existing resolver/lifecycle semantics. In particular, resolver AdmissionRefusal wraps its underlying RuntimeError/OSError, while a later factory start error preserves its own identity. Removing Python references is not retirement.

Sixteen new ordered cases are proposed in EXPECTED-CASES.json. They use the actual parser, admission orchestration, lifecycle, factory and new extension with the existing inert reservation fixture and fixed fake filesystem observations. Their isolated module-pair contract is in FIXTURE-LOADER-CONTRACT.md. No new test, import, Python startup, native call or artifact read has occurred. The accepted tests, generated paths, resolver, lifecycle, protocol and constructor sources are not edited. SOURCE-INPUTS.json binds actual derivative bytes and the original text inputs; hashes are not qualification results.
